method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the steps with deadlines in Rules s 15(2) and s 74(2) are regulative rules (PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE) run inside plain-fact questions; no REFUSE (sections that do not reach the facts say so, s 26(6) answers NOTHING, all asserted); the Operator's findings and satisfactions are inputs or conditional answers; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. First encoding in the Rules' own folder; the parent Act's baseline (which brought in Rules ss 4B, 6, 11, 12, 15, 26(3)-(5), 33(3)) is untouched. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: National Redress Scheme for Institutional Child Sexual Abuse Rules 2018, Compilation No. 9, compilation date 2025-02-19 (register id F2025C00180; Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/F2018L00975.txt. From the parent Act (C2024C00613, deposited at subjects/au/national-redress-scheme-for-institutional-child-sexual-abuse-act-2018/registers/source-bundle/C2018A00045.txt): the scheme sunset day (s 193(1)(a)). The assessment framework is not deposited, so its result is an input.

checks.result: 163 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; 2 #TRACEs each a BREACH as its expect line says (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A breached DEONTIC cannot be compared with EQUALS on this l4, so traces are asserted through a CONSIDER ... WHEN FULFILLED helper and breaches are #TRACEd.

scope: From the survivor's seat: Rules ss 4 (definitions used), 4B, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 17, 26(1)-(5) (and (6) as NOTHING), 31, 33, 34, 35, 35A-35C, 37, 39, 42, 43, 44-54A, 71, 72, 73, 74. Out: ss 1, 3 and the simplified outlines; Part 4A (s 15B, laws that may stop third parties giving information); Part 6 Divisions 2, 4-7 (ss 19-25, 27-29A, cost sharing among institutions, whose formulas the deposit lost); s 31A and Part 8A (notices to funders and institutions); Parts 11A, 11B (lists of named State or Territory institutions); Parts 12, 13 (participating institutions and groups, financial matters); s 74A; s 75.
seat: the survivor (a person sexually abused as a child in circumstances an institution was responsible for, who applies for redress; in ss 33(3) and 34-35C, the family member, executor or other person asking on a deceased applicant's behalf)
